Hadn't played an AC game in years. Never considered buying this but was gifted a copy.

Lots of people seem to hate it. I loved this game. Glad I gave it a chance.

Loved the combat. You can play stealthy if you want. You can run in like a berserker and smash everything you see.
It has boats, you can turn into a bird, you can teleport kill your enemies.
There is so much to do and you can spend hundreds of hours easily if you want to finish all the content. The map is large, even without the DLC. It's easy to traverse and filled with wildlife and side quests.

The story is good. I did struggle at times just because of the size of the world. I would forget who the person was that I was helping, confusing them with others.

The leveling system works well for this type of game. Searching for new armors/weapons in every area was fun for me too, especially with the ability to customize all my equipment depending on what I found and upgraded.
DLC was cool and added some flavor.

This game goes on sale regularly. Pick it up next time it is.

If there were at least achievements for this line of work, that would be okay, but not even that. In addition, the Ubisoft launcher hangs up after every play session because it doesn't synchronise with the cloud. Good money thrown away for poor quality. Not recommendable.

This is honestly a good game. I have played 170+ hours of this game and did everything from DLC to mainstory and side etc... There is honestly sooo much to do and it is fun to do even mysteries on the map as well are fun to figure out and rewarding. I know die hard AC fans will be like oh this is not in line with the OG AC story etc and what not... but so what? Is it fun? Yes it is, Is it still an assassin creed game? Yes. This game will throw a of fun curve balls at you but will keep you wanting more. Visually beautiful game, and sounds as well combat is fluid and enjoyable. I think this game can be even worth it at full price with how much content it comes with as is to explore, but if you are one of those not so sure people to get it or not. I would recommend wait for a sale and try it out. Give it a chance and learn the basics and grow from there ;)

I have played several AC games, but have had many gaps since Black Flag. I must admit, following the fun I had in Odyssey, I was expecting more from this title.
The story is quite bland, the quests very repetitive, but worst of all, the instability of the game really irks me. I constantly crash in the most random situations - and it seems like another rushed AAA title.
Buy it on sale if you are a big AC fan, otherwise, wait for the next good one.

It says playable on the Steam Deck but it really isn't.

It will run if you succeed in progressing from Ubisoft's clunky launcher, which in itself can be a hassle. When it's actually runny it does so smoothly, until it crashes. It can happen anywhere, but mostly in cutscenes.

I have tried every setting I could think of to make it run; custom VULKAN-dll mods, FSR, resolution, Cryo's swappiness mod, UMA-VRAM in BIOS.

The gameplay still attracts, but you cannot really enjoy it on a Steam Deck. I don't think anyone should buy it for the Steam Deck at all. Not until UBISOFT optimizes the game for the DECK themselves and removes/optimizes their infuriating launcher.
The current experience is very anti-gamer and anti-consumer.

After 400h i can say it's a nice game if you have enough time to play it. It's not really a ac game per se and it's quite inaccurate when it comes to history. It's a mix of hobbit, Hollywood vikings with a pinch of ac and Norse mythology. There are some bugs as you can expect from Ubisoft, but nothing out of ordinary. Main story is average and i personally preferred dlc stories. Environment is beautiful. Gameplay is quite fun but grinding is out of control, plus a lot of fun weapons and equipment you only get toward the end of the game. So if you have time and game is on sale i would recommend it.

I originally reviewed this game 2.1hrs in "One of the best AC games, great combat" Now, after nearly 30 hours, the game has gotten boring, repetitive, and there is very rarely new content to find. Also, it probably has the most amount of microtransactions in any game, and Ubi originally promised there would be NONE. Classic AAA move. Although I see some people who would like this game, it'snot worth your time and money. I did buy it on 75% off sale, but I would only recommend it if you could buy it for under $10 (AUD). Overall, 2/10.
